events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday, known for his iconic roles in Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, John!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate and discovery. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost an irreplaceable talent. Remembering the extraordinary Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showcased their incredible growth as songwriters and musicians.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years on, John Lennon's message of peace and his incredible musical legacy continue to resonate. Remembering a true icon today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80 Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and unparalleled artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Forever a trailblazer.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll' Elvis Presley would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Heavenly Birthday, King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Remembering the incomparable Elvis Presley and his enduring impact on music and culture.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of so many iconic riffs, his influence is immeasurable.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Rod!
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs (Madness) turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs 66th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic tunes.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Paul Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still loving those 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The beloved country music legend Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly 81 Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have turned 81 today. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Gary!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true music maestro.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Billy Ocean
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get going! Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean.

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame welcomed its first class of legends. Who was in that groundbreaking inaugural group?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Mark!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got those moves.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their unforgettable final live performance. An iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Singer, songwriter, and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Phil!
angles.copy: Another year older for the legendary Phil Collins, who turns 76 today! From Genesis to solo superstardom, what's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Hugh!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! Our favourite rom-com leading man.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, JT!
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back and celebrating his 46th birthday! Happy birthday to the incredible Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor Sir David Jason, known for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Sir David!
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: 68 years ago, music lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.
